description: This file defines a C# class 'MySqlStorageForTesting' that extends 'RelationalStorageForTesting' to provide MySQL-specific database setup, teardown, and testing utilities for unit tests.

classes.name: MySqlStorageForTesting
classes.description: A test utility class for managing MySQL database setup and testing within unit tests, extending 'RelationalStorageForTesting'.

methods.name: SplitScript
methods.description: Splits a SQL setup script into executable batches, replacing 'END$$' with 'END;' and splitting on delimiters.

methods.name: ConvertToExecutableBatches
methods.description: Converts a setup script into a list of executable SQL batches, appending the create stream test table command.
